title: Vibrant Shattering Greek Pears Horiatiki Salad
description: A refreshing and nostalgic Greek dish featuring sashimi-cut pears, this salad is a perfect combination of herbal flavors and crunchy texture, diabetic-friendly and made in a cast-iron skillet.
instructions: Preheat the cast-iron skillet over medium heat.
In a large bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, sliced cucumber, and thinly sliced red onion.
Add the sashimi-cut pears to the bowl and gently toss to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, and dried oregano.
Pour the dressing over the pear and vegetable mixture and toss to coat.
Crumble the feta cheese over the top of the salad and sprinkle with pitted kalamata olives.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the salad to the preheated cast-iron skillet and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional oregano and lemon wedges, if desired.
